mapper.sql: select id, template_id, name, paper, orientation, title, logo_file_id, field_map, show_signature, show_comment, show_attachment, show_cc_node, watermark, footer_note, enable_flag, del_flag, create_id, create_by, create_time, update_id, update_by, update_time from t_template_print_template
mapper.select: where template_id = #{templateId} and del_flag = '0' and enable_flag = '1' order by update_time desc

select template_id from ( select template_id, 1 as ord from t_workflow_todo where business_id = #{businessId} and template_id is not null union all select template_id, 2 as ord from t_workflow_done where business_id = #{businessId} and template_id is not null union all select template_id, 3 as ord from t_workflow_recycle where business_id = #{businessId} and template_id is not null union all select template_id, 4 as ord from t_workflow_form where id = #{businessId} and template_id is not null union all select template_id, 5 as ord from t_workflow_my_draft where biz_id = #{businessId} and template_id is not null ) t order by ord limit 1
select builtin_print_key from t_template where id = #{templateId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_template_print_template ( id, template_id, name, paper, orientation, title, logo_file_id, field_map, show_signature, show_comment, show_attachment, show_cc_node, watermark, footer_note, enable_flag, del_flag, create_id, create_by, create_time, update_id, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{templateId}, #{name}, #{paper}, #{orientation}, #{title}, #{logoFileId}, #{fieldMap}, #{showSignature}, #{showComment}, #{showAttachment}, #{showCcNode}, #{watermark}, #{footerNote}, #{enableFlag}, '0', #{createId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateId}, #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update t_template_print_template set del_flag = '1', update_id = #{updateId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
